senses.gloss:
लेह, अस्, m. licking, tasting; one who licks, a
licker, sipper, (मधुनो लेहः, a sipper of honey,
a bee, = मधु-लिह्); anything to be taken by
licking, a lambative, electuary; food; epithet of one
of the ten ways in which an eclipse can take place;
(ई), f. a particular disease of the tips of the ears.
लेह लेह, लेहन, लेह्य. See p. 868, col. 2.
लेहक, अस्, m. one who licks, a licker, taster.

लेहन, अम्, n. the act of licking, tasting or
lapping with the tongue.

लेहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be licked, &c., = लेह्य
below.

लेहम्, ind. having licked, &c., (क्षीर-लेहम्,
having licked milk.)
लेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, licking, a licker; [cf. मधु-ल्˚.]

लेह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be licked, lickable, capable
of being licked, to be lapped or licked up or eaten
by licking; (अम्), n. nectar, ambrosia, food that is
licked or sipped, a lambative, syrup, electuary;
food in general.
